name: Robly
description_en:
Robly is a product in the Email marketing category. Its directory profile covers Abandoned Cart Email, Delivery by Time Zone, Send Time Optimization, Sign Up Forms, Free Stock Photos, Predesigned Email Templates, Email Scheduling, Contact List Import.

Additional listed capabilities include Click Map, Real-time Email Editor, Document Library, List Segmentation, Drag and Drop Editor, A/B Testing, Template Management, Spam Check. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Freelancers. API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as 24/7 (Live rep), Business Hours, Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $15.0.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: compare variants using a defined outcome measure; organize and reuse predefined structures; store and organize people, organizations and their contact details. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
Robly 属于邮件营销软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括弃购提醒邮件、按时区投递、发送时间优化、注册表单、免费图库素材、预设邮件模板、邮件排程、联系人名单导入。

资料还列出点击分布图、实时邮件编辑器、文档库、名单分组、拖放编辑器、A/B 测试、模板管理、垃圾邮件风险检查。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织 自由职业者。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为全天候人工支持, 工作时间支持, 在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：提供免费试用 起价为 $15.0.。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：使用明确的结果指标比较不同版本；整理并复用预设内容结构；集中保存和整理联系人、组织及其联系方式。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
